name: Career World Portfolio · Round 1
domainSummary: An interactive evidence-oriented portfolio world that maps employers, projects, and skills into a navigable 2.5D hierarchy using React, TypeScript, operator control, and explicit data contracts.
evidenceBoundary: Do not render resume text, screenshots, labels, browser chrome, or invented evidence content.

researchSources.title: Career World project art brief
researchSources.use: Accepted cartographer pavilion, viewpoint, courtyard, and evidence-gallery identity.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Canonical Amplification
assets.controlledVariable: refine and amplify the accepted baseline geometry while preserving its defining silhouette; emphasize navigable employer-project-skill hierarchy
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested at its most resolved supporting-landmark scale. This version emphasizes navigable employer-project-skill hierarchy.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Process Spine
assets.controlledVariable: recompose the landmark along a clear sequential service spine with repeated but unequal chambers; emphasize cartographic spatial orientation
assets.thesis: A visible spatial sequence makes the project's process legible without arrows or diagrams. This version emphasizes cartographic spatial orientation.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Exchange Bridge
assets.controlledVariable: divide the major functions into unequal connected masses joined by one inhabited structural bridge; emphasize evidence-linked exploration
assets.thesis: A physical bridge tests whether handoff and exchange should dominate the identity. This version emphasizes evidence-linked exploration.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Checkpoint Court
assets.controlledVariable: organize the building around a protected validation court with layered thresholds and one decisive exit; emphasize operator-controlled focus
assets.thesis: A central court makes review, validation, or adjudication the primary metaphor. This version emphasizes operator-controlled focus.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Terraced Escalation
assets.controlledVariable: step the landmark upward through three or four connected terraces toward one compact focus; emphasize contract-driven asset registry
assets.thesis: Terraced hierarchy expresses staged progress and increasing commitment. This version emphasizes contract-driven asset registry.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Modular Batch
assets.controlledVariable: build the landmark from repeatable unequal modules locked to one continuous service base; emphasize navigable employer-project-skill hierarchy
assets.thesis: Repeatable modules test batch, scale, and replaceability without detached pieces. This version emphasizes navigable employer-project-skill hierarchy.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Guarded Recovery
assets.controlledVariable: place a protected core inside redundant connected routes with one visibly joined recovery annex; emphasize cartographic spatial orientation
assets.thesis: Guardrails and recovery become architectural without implying an unverified implementation. This version emphasizes cartographic spatial orientation.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Asymmetric Landmark
assets.controlledVariable: concentrate height and mass off-center to create one singular project-scale skyline; emphasize evidence-linked exploration
assets.thesis: A deliberately asymmetric silhouette tests recognition at map scale. This version emphasizes evidence-linked exploration.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Compact Deployment
assets.controlledVariable: compress the domain into the smallest dense, coherent project building that retains the accepted identity; emphasize operator-controlled focus
assets.thesis: Compression tests which visual cues are essential rather than merely decorative. This version emphasizes operator-controlled focus.

assets.name: Career World Portfolio · Domain Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance the strongest baseline, process, validation, exchange, and recovery cues in one resolved composition; emphasize contract-driven asset registry
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a mature all-around project identity without becoming a city capital. This version emphasizes contract-driven asset registry.
